name: SECURITY DEFINER trigger assurance
acceptanceCriteria: Repository migrations produce a reviewed inventory of every application-owned SECURITY DEFINER trigger function and effective trigger attachment, including ordered CREATE, ALTER, DROP, GRANT, and REVOKE semantics.
The live Supabase catalog is compared read-only with repository truth and any live-only or repository-only function, trigger, ACL, search_path, or wiring difference is recorded as unresolved drift.

High-risk trigger behavior is not marked verified until external effects are safely stubbed or isolated and rollback-contained owner, cross-user, anonymous, idempotency, and cleanup probes pass with zero retained synthetic rows.

verification.evidence: Read-only production pg_catalog observation recorded 11 application-owned SECURITY DEFINER trigger functions and 14 attachments. Repository structural enforcement is under exact-head CI. Behavioral probes remain intentionally unverified because pg_net and other external effects are not yet isolated.
